description:
Verify the OpenAI Responses HTTP and WebSocket lanes with curated fixtures and scenario-backed coverage.

Scope:
- maintain a small anchor set of OpenAI models that prove the important lanes
- capture HTTP and WebSocket fixtures where they demonstrate real architectural differences
- verify object, tool, image, reasoning, and transport-specific behavior across the chosen anchors
- identify drift between HTTP and WebSocket behavior and map it back to the correct layer

Testing posture:
- replay first, then deliberate live recording for missing or drift-prone cases
title: Verify OpenAI Responses HTTP and WebSocket lanes
